commenti.body: The comparison has been made for 20 years but to my knowledge, the filmmakers have never come out and directly said if it was an homage or just a coincidence.  The plot device of Teorema has been copied countless times though.

Thanks for sharing, when I'm able to sit at my desk dig into some actual research i can't wait to see what else falls on the list. 

This is one of my favorite "discovering" movies, when you fall into the rabbit hole of "well i wonder what else was inspired by this?" 

​

Thanks again

It's likely, but Japan made a bunch of (bizarre) films about dysfunctional families in the 80s and 90s like The Family Game, The Crazy Family, The Yen Family, A Sandcastle Model Family Home, etc. I always figured it was a play on those.
I've not heard of these movies but I'm putting them on my list. Thanks!
